description: Stockfish 19's UCI option sets, one per purpose (docs/guides/chess-forward-pass-proof.md, Stockfish experiment profiles). Every option a profile names is sent and receipted; an option it does not name keeps the engine default. SyzygyPath is the installed 3-4-5 set (LAPLACE_SYZYGY), so SyzygyProbeLimit declares the boundary those tables cover. The tables are a calculation provider Stockfish probes, not content Laplace depends on.

identity.note: bench (16 MB hash, 1 thread, depth 13, the default positions) is the generation's identity: a different node count is a different engine, whatever the ARCH or compiler.

testimony.use: deterministic calculation provider and census: reproducible on every host
testimony.search: go nodes N (or go depth D), ucinewgame before each independent position, no clock

calibration.use: graded opponent on Stockfish's CCRL 40/4 anchored scale; non-deterministic by design (time-seeded skill PRNG): comparator evidence, never testimony
calibration.search: tc=120+1 (the clock UCI_Elo is calibrated at), engines pinned to equal P-cores

ladder.use: a rung of the ladder and the frozen fixed reference: full strength, node-limited, hardware-independent

analysis.use: deep single-position analysis on the host's spare cores; not bit-reproducible
analysis.search: go depth D or go nodes N; large pages are used when the operator holds Lock pages in memory

play.use: host-max opponent and Lichess play; not bit-reproducible
play.search: a clock; Move Overhead covers a loaded host or the network
